sobre-mi.title: About Me
sobre-mi.descripcion: Hello! I'm Santiago, a Software Developer focused on building robust applications and scalable web solutions. I specialize in transforming ideas into functional products through collaborative work and clear technical communication. My approach is oriented toward code excellence and the shared success of the projects I take part in.

project1.title: Argenta Real Estate Manager
project1.description: Fullstack real estate management platform featuring multi-level caching (Redis and TanStack Query), real-time dynamic filtering, Stripe payment integration, and Supabase automations.

project2.title: Argenta Real Estate
project2.description: Real estate management system with component-driven architecture, implementing full CRUD operations, real-time dynamic filtering, and SQL database persistence.

project3.title: DOC PANEL
project3.description: A software application for managing patient clinical studies, scheduling appointments, generating reports, and storing study images. Features a PostgreSQL database, cloud storage buckets for images, and a DEMO version.

project4.title: Technical Assessment | EGO
project4.description: Frontend technical assessment for a company that required developing a landing page, respecting the provided design as closely as possible.

project5.title: Hardware Store
project5.description: A simple, design-focused website for an online hardware store. It features a fully functional shopping cart section and a promotional carousel.

project6.title: GIF Search Engine
project6.description: Software developed to search for any GIF on the web quickly and easily.
